notes: Bundled indicators are TEST FIXTURES only. Load real feeds through the backend (see backend/README.md: URLhaus, Echap stalkerware-indicators).

indicators.source: Sentinel test fixture (.invalid TLD, never resolvable)

yara:
// Sentinel YARA-lite rules. Heuristic unless meta type = "signature".
rule EICAR_Test_File {
  meta:
    type = "signature"
    severity = "high"
    title_en = "EICAR anti-malware test file"
    title_fr = "Fichier de test antivirus EICAR"
    description = "Harmless industry-standard test string used to verify detection pipelines."
    description_fr = "Chaîne de test standard et inoffensive servant à vérifier la détection."
  strings:
    $eicar = "X5O!P%@AP[4\\PZX54(P^)7CC)7}$EICAR-STANDARD-ANTIVIRUS-TEST-FILE!$H+H*"
  condition:
    $eicar
}

rule Dynamic_Code_Loading {
  meta:
    severity = "low"
    title_en = "Loads code at runtime"
    title_fr = "Charge du code à l'exécution"
    description = "Uses DexClassLoader/InMemoryDexClassLoader; common in SDKs, also used by droppers to fetch payloads after review."
    description_fr = "Utilise DexClassLoader/InMemoryDexClassLoader ; courant dans les SDK, aussi utilisé par les droppers."
  strings:
    $a = "Ldalvik/system/DexClassLoader;"
    $b = "Ldalvik/system/InMemoryDexClassLoader;"
    $c = "loadClass"
  condition:
    ($a or $b) and $c
}

rule Accessibility_Overlay_Abuse {
  meta:
    severity = "medium"
    title_en = "Accessibility automation with overlays"
    title_fr = "Automatisation d'accessibilité avec superpositions"
    description = "Combines reading the active window, performing global actions and drawing overlays: the toolkit of banking trojans."
    description_fr = "Combine lecture de la fenêtre active, actions globales et superpositions : la panoplie des chevaux de Troie bancaires."
  strings:
    $root = "getRootInActiveWindow"
    $glob = "performGlobalAction"
    $over = "TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY"
    $over2 = "addView"
    $acc = "Landroid/accessibilityservice/AccessibilityService;"
  condition:
    $acc and $root and $glob and ($over or $over2)
}

rule Hidden_Launcher_Icon {
  meta:
    severity = "low"
    title_en = "Can hide its launcher icon"
    title_fr = "Peut masquer son icône"
    description = "Disables its own launcher component, a technique stalkerware uses to stay out of sight."
    description_fr = "Désactive son propre composant de lancement, technique utilisée par les stalkerwares pour rester invisibles."
  strings:
    $set = "setComponentEnabledSetting"
    $launcher = "android.intent.category.LAUNCHER"
  condition:
    $set and $launcher
}

rule Root_Command_Execution {
  meta:
    severity = "low"
    title_en = "Executes root shell commands"
    title_fr = "Exécute des commandes root"
    description = "Spawns 'su' through Runtime.exec; legitimate for root tools, abused by malware to escalate."
    description_fr = "Lance 'su' via Runtime.exec ; légitime pour les outils root, abusé par des malwares."
  strings:
    $rt = "Ljava/lang/Runtime;"
    $exec = "exec"
    $su1 = "/system/xbin/su"
    $su2 = "/system/bin/su"
  condition:
    $rt and $exec and any of ($su1, $su2)
}

rule Call_Audio_Recording {
  meta:
    severity = "medium"
    title_en = "Records phone-call audio"
    title_fr = "Enregistre l'audio des appels"
    description = "References call-state monitoring together with media recording, consistent with covert call recording."
    description_fr = "Associe surveillance de l'état d'appel et enregistrement audio, compatible avec un enregistrement d'appels caché."
  strings:
    $rec = "Landroid/media/MediaRecorder;"
    $state = "android.intent.action.PHONE_STATE"
    $src = "setAudioSource"
  condition:
    all of them
}

rule SMS_Interception {
  meta:
    severity = "medium"
    title_en = "Intercepts SMS messages"
    title_fr = "Intercepte les SMS"
    description = "Receives SMS broadcasts and extracts message bodies; used for stealing one-time codes."
    description_fr = "Reçoit les SMS et extrait leur contenu ; utilisé pour voler des codes à usage unique."
  strings:
    $rx = "android.provider.Telephony.SMS_RECEIVED"
    $pdu = "createFromPdu"
    $body = "getMessageBody"
  condition:
    $rx and $pdu and $body
}

rule Device_Admin_Lock {
  meta:
    severity = "low"
    title_en = "Can lock or wipe the device"
    title_fr = "Peut verrouiller ou effacer l'appareil"
    description = "Uses device-admin lock/wipe APIs (ransomware lockers, also anti-theft tools)."
    description_fr = "Utilise les API d'administration verrouiller/effacer (rançongiciels, aussi antivols)."
  strings:
    $recv = "Landroid/app/admin/DeviceAdminReceiver;"
    $lock = "lockNow"
    $wipe = "wipeData"
  condition:
    $recv and ($lock or $wipe)
}
